  INNER JOIN ${catalog}.${raw_schema}.patient p
    ON r.patient_id = p.source_member_id

  WHERE r.batch_id = '${batch_id}'

  SELECT
    mes.cinq_id,
    mes.insurance_id,

    ) AS dup_seq

    r.drg_code, cast(null as string) AS drg_code_desc, r.drg_code_system,
    r.bill_type, r.admission_type, r.admission_source, r.discharge_status,
    r.claim_adjustment_type_cd, r.claim_status, r.reason_for_visit,
    r.actual_length_of_stay, r.covered_length_of_stay, r.line_of_business, r.product, r.primary_payer,

  INNER JOIN enrollment_match mes
    ON r.patient_id = mes.patient_id
   AND mes.dup_seq = 1
),
with_ods AS (
  SELECT
    e.batch_id, e.record_hash, e.ods_record_hash, e.is_active,
    e.created_by, e.created_at, e.updated_by, e.updated_at, e.source_system, e.business_key_hash,
    e.source_claim_id, e.claim_type, e.source_resource_id, e.source_resource_type, e.source_format,
    e.patient_id, e.source_billing_org_id, e.source_rendering_org_id,
    e.admission_date, e.discharge_date, e.statement_from, e.statement_through, e.paid_date,
    e.claim_effective_date, e.claim_received_date, e.claim_version_num, e.adjusted_claim_id,
    e.drg_code, coalesce(o.drg_code_desc, e.drg_code_desc) AS drg_code_desc, e.drg_code_system,
    e.bill_type, e.admission_type, e.admission_source, e.discharge_status,
    e.claim_adjustment_type_cd, e.claim_status, e.reason_for_visit,
    e.actual_length_of_stay, e.covered_length_of_stay, e.line_of_business, e.product, e.primary_payer,

    coalesce(o.patient_sk, e.patient_sk) AS patient_sk,

      WHEN coalesce(e.ods_record_hash, '') <> coalesce(o.ods_record_hash, '') THEN 'UPDATE'
      ELSE 'NOOP'

  FROM enriched e

    SELECT o.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.source_claim_id
        ORDER BY coalesce(o.updated_at, o.created_at) DESC, o.batch_id DESC
      ) AS dup_seq
    FROM ${catalog}.${ods_schema}.claim_header o
    WHERE coalesce(o.is_active, true) = true
  ) o
    ON o.source_claim_id = e.source_claim_id
   AND o.dup_seq = 1
)
SELECT * FROM with_ods WHERE cdc_action <> 'NOOP'
) x WHERE cdc_action = 'INSERT'

    e.batch_id, e.record_hash, e.ods_record_hash, e.is_active,
    e.created_by, e.created_at, e.updated_by, e.updated_at, e.source_system, e.business_key_hash,
    e.source_claim_id, e.line_number, e.adjudication_type, e.adjudication_category_code,
    e.adjudication_category_bb_code,
    coalesce(o.adjudication_category_code_desc, e.adjudication_category_code_desc) AS adjudication_category_code_desc,
    e.adjudication_category_system, e.adjudication_reason_code,
    coalesce(o.adjudication_reason_code_desc, e.adjudication_reason_code_desc) AS adjudication_reason_code_desc,
    e.adjudication_reason_system, e.amount, e.currency, e.value,
    coalesce(o.claim_line_adjudication_sk, uuid()) AS claim_line_adjudication_sk,
    coalesce(o.claim_line_sk, e.parent_claim_line_sk) AS claim_line_sk,
    CASE
      WHEN o.claim_line_adjudication_sk IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
      WHEN coalesce(e.is_active, true) = false AND coalesce(o.is_active, true) = true THEN 'DELETE'
      WHEN coalesce(e.is_active, true) = true AND coalesce(o.is_active, true) = false THEN 'UPDATE'
      WHEN coalesce(e.record_hash, '') <> coalesce(o.record_hash, '') THEN 'UPDATE'
      WHEN coalesce(e.ods_record_hash, '') <> coalesce(o.ods_record_hash, '') THEN 'UPDATE'
      ELSE 'NOOP'
    END AS cdc_action
  FROM enriched e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.business_key_hash
        ORDER BY coalesce(o.updated_at, o.created_at) DESC, o.batch_id DESC
      ) AS dup_seq
    FROM ${catalog}.${ods_schema}.claim_line_adjudication o
    WHERE coalesce(o.is_active, true) = true
  ) o
    ON o.business_key_hash = e.business_key_hash
   AND o.dup_seq = 1
)
SELECT * FROM with_ods WHERE cdc_action <> 'NOOP'
) x WHERE cdc_action = 'UPDATE'
